patches.name: fastify5-loopback-worker
patches.reason: Migrate the pinned RPC server to Fastify 5: custom loggerInstance, a bounded unmatched-route metric label, async WebSocket registration, and loopback binding.

sourceReplacements.find: logger: logger as FastifyBaseLogger, // workaround for https://github.com/fastify/fastify/issues/4960
sourceReplacements.replace: loggerInstance: logger as unknown as FastifyBaseLogger,

patches.name: strict-trace-outer-result
patches.reason: Expose the outer simulation result; the inner DelegateAndRevert is not the Pimlico result.

replacements.replace:
output: toHex(_ctx.output), error: _ctx.error || null,
                callsFromEntryPoint: this.callsFromEntryPoint,

sourceReplacements.replace:
output: toHex(_ctx.output), error: (_ctx as LogContext & { error?: string }).error || null,
                callsFromEntryPoint: this.callsFromEntryPoint,

patches.name: strict-simulation-return-decoding
patches.reason: Match strict validation to the return ABI of the same pinned simulation contracts; retain all signature, validity, storage and opcode checks.

patches.name: fastify5-telemetry
patches.reason: Preserve optional Fastify tracing on v5 using the maintained @fastify/otel adapter (npm alias), registered before route initialization.

patches.name: fastify5-decorator-type
patches.reason: Represent the existing null request decorator accurately in Fastify 5 types; installed decorator behavior is unchanged.

patches.name: typescript7-yargs-type
patches.reason: Import the Argv type explicitly for TypeScript 7; the CLI runtime code is unchanged.

remappings.reason: Freeze the exact compiler remappings recorded in the pinned published artifacts; disable directory-dependent automatic remappings.

sourceBuild.packageManager: npm with separate runtime and build-tool lockfiles; upstream pnpm 8 is not used
